annotations.text:
A · SPATIAL OS
The literal umbrelOS feel: floating glass widgets over an ambient scene, a pill dock.
Best at: personality, instant "this is different."
Tradeoff: most work to keep tidy; risks style over substance.

B · EDITORIAL GLASS
Reading-first. One quiet column, serif headline, glass only where it earns it.
Best at: making the writing the hero; ages well.
Tradeoff: calmer, less "wow" on first load.

C · SCENE GALLERY
Your analogies lead. Each piece is a big scene card (line-art now, 3D renders later).
Best at: showcasing the visuals you want to make.
Tradeoff: leans on having strong art per post.
